Tidemill Logistics Park trades at $164 per square foot

Tidemill Logistics Park sold for $164 per square foot in 2025. The 640,000 square foot port-side park drew six bidders.

The park is fully let to three logistics operators on leases averaging seven years.

Tidemill Logistics Park is a fictional property used in a software demonstration; this article was prepared for a software demonstration.
